title_zh: 打印机生产与共享产能
description_en: An office supply company makes two types of printers: color printers and black and white printers. Different sections of the factory with different teams produce each printer. The color printer team can produce at most 20 color printers per day while the black and white printer team can produce at most 30 black and white printers per day. Both teams require use of the same paper tray installing machine and this machine can make at most 35 printers of either type each day. Color printers generate a profit of $200 per printer while black and white printers generate a profit of $70 per printer. How many of each printer should be made to maximize the company's profit?
description_zh: 彩色、黑白打印机日产能分别不超过20和30台，共享设备使总量不超过35台，单台利润分别为200和70。如何安排产量使利润最大？
modeling_notes_en: In this demo printer counts are nonnegative integers. This is an explicit interpretation of indivisible products, not an integer label claimed from NL4Opt. Keep the given entity order. Quantity unit: printers. Objective unit: dollars. Constraint units: printers/day.

source.derivation: English document copied; Chinese explanation and entity identifiers added; integer interpretation disclosed
